disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Activity timestamps reflect commit author dates and public GitHub event records. Do not infer actual working hours, effort, or developer productivity solely from timestamp distribution.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Aggregated from public push events, commits, and pull requests accessible via GitHub Public API for the selected timeframe.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Developer comparisons measure public repository counts, stars, forks, and detected languages. Metrics do not measure overall skill, code quality, or engineering competence.

measurement_period.title: Measurement Period
measurement_period.default: All public repository data available via GitHub API

data_disclaimer.title: Data Disclaimer
data_disclaimer.default: Metrics reflect publicly accessible GitHub repositories and events only. Private activity is excluded unless authorized.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: DevInsights Repository Health is an algorithmic, rules-based diagnostic score calculated from public maintenance indicators, documentation checks, and issue activity. It is not an official GitHub rating or a definitive measure of software quality.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: GitHub repository language statistics estimate code byte composition across repository default branches, not hours worked or time spent coding.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Portfolio audit generates heuristic recommendations based on recruiter readability and open-source best practices. It does not predict employment outcomes or job suitability.
